preferences: All Claude-family providers must use explicit 1M-context model IDs with [1m] in the model name. Never use Claude aliases such as claude/opus, claude/sonnet, or claude/fable when launching Paseo agents.

Always run Claude-family Paseo agents in bypassPermissions mode. Always run Codex Paseo agents in full-access mode. Do not launch restricted/approval-gated agents unless Raj explicitly asks for a safer sandbox for that task.
Fable 5 1M is the top-level orchestrator/planner/synthesizer/final reviewer. Use high thinking by default, not xhigh/max, unless Raj explicitly asks or the task is existential/high-stakes.
Opus 4.8 1M is the deep-reasoning agent for architecture, root-cause debugging, hard product tradeoffs, and second opinions. Use xhigh thinking and bypassPermissions.
Codex GPT-5.5 is the implementation/mechanical/audit workhorse. Use xhigh thinking and full-access.

Sonnet 5 1M is a mid-tier Claude taste/UX/copy/styling worker when Fable/Opus would be overkill. Prefer high thinking and bypassPermissions when used; do not use it for bulk mechanical work over Codex.

For high-stakes decisions, run Fable or Opus plus Codex in parallel and synthesize. Keep the top-level orchestrator context lean by delegating repo scans, implementation, verification, and computer-use-heavy work.
